Resolution criteria:
- "Seattle Mariners": Wins if the Seattle Mariners have a higher final score than the Milwaukee Brewers at the conclusion of the MLB game played on August 20, 2026 at American Family Field in Milwaukee.
- "Milwaukee Brewers": Wins if the Milwaukee Brewers have a higher final score than the Seattle Mariners at the conclusion of the MLB game played on August 20, 2026 at American Family Field in Milwaukee.

Clarifications:
- The official final score is determined after all regulation innings (and any extra innings, if necessary) are completed. If the game is postponed and not completed on August 20, 2026 (UTC), resolve using the official result of the rescheduled game; if the game is cancelled with no result declared, this market is void.
